summary.content:
Today's selection covers 59 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 35 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Is Showing Kalshi’s World Cup Odds in ChatGPT
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: US sanctions VPN, malware providers for enabling ransomware attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
